title: dispatch --detach and begin print a coord wait command with --since 0, which returns at once on the item's earlier claimed and working events
goal: The wait command that dispatch --detach and begin print starts after the events already posted for the item, so with a live worker and no new event it ends only at its timeout or when the worker process has ended

run:
import json,os,re,shlex,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp"));rem=d/"remote.git"
s.run(["git","init","-q","--bare","-b","main",str(rem)],check=True);r=d/"clone"
s.run(["git","clone","-q",str(rem),str(r)],check=True,capture_output=True)
g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch","worktree_dir":"wt","land_push":["git","push","origin","HEAD:main"]}))
(r/"items").mkdir();(r/".gitignore").write_text("_cache/\nwt/\n")
def item(i,**k):
    x=dict(id=i,kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]);x.update(k)
    (r/"items"/(i+".json")).write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+"\n")
(r/"items"/"SP-cccccccc.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id":"SP-cccccccc","kind":"sprint","title":"s","status":"active","goal":"g"}))
(r/"x.txt").write_text("x")
item("ST-aaaaaaaa",sprint="SP-cccccccc")
g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i");g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:main");g("fetch","-q","origin")
b=d/"bin";b.mkdir();(b/"claude").write_text("#!/bin/sh\ncat >/dev/null\nsleep 12\necho \x27{\"subtype\":\"success\",\"num_turns\":1,\"total_cost_usd\":0,\"session_id\":\"s1\",\"result\":\"done\"}\x27\n");os.chmod(b/"claude",0o755)
st=str(d/"coord.sqlite")
env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=st,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk",PATH=str(b)+os.pathsep+os.environ["PATH"],GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="x",GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="x@x",GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="x",GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="x@x")
p=s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),"begin","ST-aaaaaaaa","--by","claude-chk"],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120)
m=re.search(r"coord\.py (wait [^`]*--pid (\d+))`",p.stdout)
argv=[sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py"]+shlex.split(m.group(1));argv[argv.index("--timeout")+1]="4"
w=s.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=60)
try:os.killpg(int(m.group(2)),15)
except OSError:pass
out=json.loads(w.stdout);print(p.returncode,len(out["events"]),out["timed_out"])
sys.exit(0 if out["events"]==[] and out["timed_out"] else 1)
